videos.description:
Lakhs of devotees gathered in Puri, Odisha, for the grand Jagannath Rath Yatra 2026. Lord Jagannath, Lord Balabhadra, and Devi Subhadra embarked on their sacred journey to the Gundicha Temple as thousands pulled the magnificent chariots. The Gajapati Maharaja performed the traditional Chhera Pahanra ritual, while President Droupadi Murmu, Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar, and Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings on the auspicious occasion.
